title: JoinMe
description: With the plugin JoinMe, players with permission can use the command /joinme, and then other players can use the command /tpjoin to join the player.
body:
# 🎮 JoinMe Plugin 🚀

A lightweight and simple JoinMe system inspired by popular Minecraft 🧱
servers like GommeHD 🏆. Perfect for community servers 👥, events 🎉, or
quickly
gathering players into one place 📍.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## ✨ Features

-   🚀 Start a JoinMe broadcast instantly with a single command
-   🛑 Stop the JoinMe broadcast at any time
-   ⚡ Players can teleport directly to an active JoinMe
-   🧼 Simple, fast, and performance-friendly
-   🧩 Compatible with Minecraft **1.21.10 & 1.21.11**

------------------------------------------------------------------------

🔐 Permissions
joinme.use → 🚀 Allows starting a JoinMe (/joinme)

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 📜 Commands

  Command          Description
  ---------------- ---------------------------------
  `/joinme`        🚀 Starts JoinMe
  `/joinmeclose`   🛑 Stops JoinMe
  `/tpjoin`        ⚡ Teleport to an active JoinMe

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 💡 Idea

This plugin recreates the classic JoinMe feature known from large
multiplayer networks 🌍. One player creates an invitation 📢, and others
can
instantly join and play together 🤝.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 🔧 Compatibility

-   ⛏ Minecraft 1.21.10
-   ⛏ Minecraft 1.21.11
-   🖥 Server software: Paper

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 🎯 Perfect for

-   👥 Community servers
-   🎮 Mini-games
-   🎉 Events
-   🏡 Friends-only servers
